decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the platform's beige color, matching font color, and PLATFORM component scope; no addition or edit is needed.
The source specifies platform colors but does not change the system-layout deliverable or any current layout criterion.
Matching the separate platform's colors does not change the existing DJ-inspired identity or machine render-fidelity requirement.
The platform color decision does not affect bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or mechanical clearance.
The source concerns the color of font on the platform, not the machine name, wording, placard placement, or placard sides owned by this Requirement.
The platform's beige and font colors do not alter whisk selection, attachment, positioning, removal, or bowl clearance.
The source does not change bowl capacity, bowl form, or the selected bowl-size reference.
The platform color decision does not necessarily change component selection, BOM contents, or the approved component set.
The source does not change the V1 delivery priority or the off-the-shelf sourcing policy.
The platform color and font-color matching decision does not alter splash targets or mitigation methods.
Although the platform supports cup clearance beneath the spouts, its color treatment does not change spout location, geometry, construction, orientation, or beverage-quality constraints.
